$50 Million Series B Round for Gumloop

Canada-based AI automation platform Gumloop raised $50 million in a Series B funding round led by Benchmark. The round also included participation from major institutional investors such as Nexus VP, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, The Cannon Project, and Shopify. The funding will be used to develop the platform’s AI agent infrastructure and expand its engineering team.

No-Code AI Agents and Workflow Automation

Founded in 2023 by Max Brodeur-Urbas and Rahul Behal, the platform enables users without technical infrastructure or software knowledge to create their own autonomous AI agents. These agents automate multi-step operations such as data entry, complex reporting processes, and responding to customer requests.

Gumloop’s key technical features include:

  • Model Routing: The ability to dynamically switch between different AI models—such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini—based on task requirements and cost optimization.
  • Enterprise-Scale Sharing: Accelerating organizational automation by allowing employees to share the workflows and AI agents they create with colleagues on the internal network.
  • Large-Scale Deployment: Direct integration into the operational workflows of high-volume companies such as Shopify, Ramp, Gusto, Samsara, and Instacart.

The platform aims to optimize cloud and API costs by enabling the selection of the most suitable task-based model, while delivering in-house automation processes with a minimal learning curve.
